'''Broodica''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who—along with several other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] renegades<ref name="FOD-note" />—was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. Traversing into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], Broodica and her fellow [[exiles]] proceeded to [[Slavery/Legends|conquer]] the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith civilization]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], declaring themselves [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords of the Sith]] and establishing a [[Sith Empire/Legends|new empire]].<ref name="FaD" />

Under the title of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]], Broodica developed an obsession with the ancient [[Sith scroll/Legends|scrolls]] of the Sith, particularly the power they contained. While setting out to collect such scrolls and tablets, she transferred her findings into a large [[Broodica's grimoire|personal grimoire]]. Keeping the contents of the grimoire secure, the Dark Lord Broodica sealed the [[Book/Legends|book]] using a self-designed lock, similar to a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]].<ref name="FaD" />
